name: The My Bookmarks page in the TV layout, as admin on Long Test Movie in the TV layout (localStorage 'layout' = 'tv', html.layout-tv): the My Bookmarks page hides the checkbox column and the bulk bar until the toolbar's Select toggle shows them (and drops the selection when it is turned off); every row action is a focusable button; the inline rename takes Enter and Escape from the keyboard; the Player options dialog takes the D-pad (ArrowDown and ArrowUp move the focus through its controls in order, through the kit's scopedKeys) and Escape closes it; the row menu too. Seeds and deletes its own 'page-probe tv' bookmarks; the layout is stored per browser, and each run has a fresh profile.

steps.name: find Long Test Movie
steps.eval: (await ApiClient.getItems(ApiClient.getCurrentUserId(), { IncludeItemTypes: 'Movie', Recursive: true, SearchTerm: 'Long Test Movie', Limit: 1 })).Items[0].Id

steps.name: the admin's 'page-probe tv' bookmarks of an earlier run deleted
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe tv', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); if (ids.length) await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); return ids.length;

steps.name: seed: a named range and an unnamed point
steps.script: const T = 10000000; const post = (body) => ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks'), data: JSON.stringify(body), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }); const a = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 30 * T, EndTicks: 34 * T, Name: 'page-probe tv range' }); const b = await post({ ItemId: __vars.movieId, StartTicks: 15 * T, Note: 'page-probe tv point' }); return { a: a.Id, b: b.Id };

steps.name: the page filtered to the movie
TV: the page with jfbm-page-tv, the Select toggle in the toolbar, the checkbox column and the bulk bar hidden, every row action a focusable button
steps.waitFor: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage > [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"][data-jfbm-state="on"]'); if (!r) return false; const body = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-body'); const c = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-content'); if (!c || c.hasAttribute('aria-busy')) return false; const row = c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.a + '"]'); if (!row || !c.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.b + '"]')) return false; const select = r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-select-button'); if (!select) return false; return { tv: body.classList.contains('jfbm-page-tv') && __jfkit.jfbm.instance.layout.isTv(), select: select.textContent, pressed: select.getAttribute('aria-pressed'), boxesShown: [...c.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-select')].filter(l => l.getClientRects().length > 0).length, barShown: r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-bar').getClientRects().length, actions: [...row.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-actions button')].filter(b => b.getClientRects().length > 0).map(b => [b.tagName, b.title]), pager: !!r.querySelector('.jfbm-pager') }; })()

steps.name: as expected (the More button of a narrow screen stays hidden on a TV)
the toolbar at 1366 px: the Select toggle on the search box's line, not wrapped under it (the search box starts at 8em on a TV)
steps.eval: (() => { const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); const box = (el) => el.getBoundingClientRect(); const search = box(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-toolbar .jfbm-searchbox')); const select = box(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-select-button')); const toolbar = box(r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-toolbar')); return { viewport: innerWidth, searchTop: Math.round(search.top), searchBottom: Math.round(search.bottom), searchWidth: Math.round(search.width), selectTop: Math.round(select.top), selectRight: Math.round(select.right), toolbarRight: Math.round(toolbar.right), toolbarHeight: Math.round(toolbar.height) }; })()

steps.name: the checkbox column shown; tick the range
steps.script: const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); const shown = [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-select')].filter(l => l.getClientRects().length > 0).length; r.querySelector('.jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.a + '"] .jfbm-row-select-box').click(); const bar = r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-bar'); return { pressed: r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-select-button').getAttribute('aria-pressed'), shown, barShown: bar.getClientRects().length > 0, count: bar.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-count').textContent };

steps.name: Select off: the column and the bar hidden, the selection dropped
steps.script: const r = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"]'); r.querySelector('.jfbm-page-select-button').click(); return { shown: [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-select')].filter(l => l.getClientRects().length > 0).length, barShown: r.querySelector('.jfbm-bulk-bar').getClientRects().length > 0, checked: [...r.querySelectorAll('.jfbm-row-select-box')].filter(b => b.checked).length };

steps.name: Name it on the point bookmark (from the keyboard: focus it, Enter)
steps.script: const link = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.b + '"] .jfbm-name-it'); link.focus(); return document.activeElement === link;

steps.name: the rename field focused
steps.waitFor: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.b + '"]'); const input = row && row.querySelector('.jfbm-rename input'); return !!input && document.activeElement === input; })()

steps.name: named, the focus on the row's Rename
steps.waitFor: (async () => { const row = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.b + '"]'); if (!row || row.querySelector('.jfbm-rename') || !row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title') || row.querySelector('.jfbm-row-title').textContent !== 'page-probe tv named') return false; return document.activeElement === row.querySelector('button[title="Rename"]') && (await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/' + __vars.seed.b))).Name === 'page-probe tv named'; })()

steps.name: Enter on Rename opens the field, Escape closes it
the field
steps.waitFor: (() => { const row = document.querySelector('#fallbackPage [data-jfbm-page="bookmarks"] .jfbm-row[data-id="' + __vars.seed.b + '"]'); return !!row.querySelector('.jfbm-rename input') && document.activeElement === row.querySelector('.jfbm-rename input'); })()

steps.name: the title back, the focus on Rename, the page still here
the dialog with the focus on the first field
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'Player options' && !!p.querySelector('.jfbm-options-ask') && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('.jfbm-options-ask'); })()

steps.name: the pause box has the focus (the D-pad through the kit's scopedKeys, since jellyfin-web's own navigation never runs inside)
Save (the last control; no wrap past it)
Escape closes it (a remote's Back key does the same, through the kit)
the row menu (the More button is hidden on a TV, so by script): the D-pad and Escape
the menu titled with the bookmark, the first item focused
steps.waitFor: (() => { const p = document.querySelector('.jfbm-backdrop .jfbm-panel'); return !!p && p.querySelector('h3').textContent === 'page-probe tv range' && document.activeElement === p.querySelector('.jfbm-row-menu-item'); })()

steps.name: back to the stable layout for this browser
clean-up: the 'page-probe tv' bookmarks deleted
steps.script: const r = await ApiClient.getJSON(ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/Query', { searchTerm: 'page-probe tv', limit: 200 })); const ids = r.Items.map(b => b.Id); const x = ids.length ? await ApiClient.ajax({ type: 'POST', url: ApiClient.getUrl('Bookmarks/BulkDelete'), data: JSON.stringify({ Ids: ids, DeleteClips: true }), contentType: 'application/json', dataType: 'json' }) : { Deleted: [] }; return { ids: ids.length, deleted: x.Deleted.length };
